types.name: Value
types.description: A typed value of any type.

fields.name: address
fields.description: The numeric address of the value.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The actual value, which may be a primitive or a structured object.

types.name: Pointer
types.description: Rust raw pointer, reference, or NonNull-like pointer value.

fields.name: address
fields.description: The numeric address.

fields.name: allocation
fields.description: The allocation/provenance object the pointer is derived from.

fields.name: offset
fields.description: The byte offset from the start of its allocation.

fields.name: is_null
fields.description: Whether the pointer address is zero.

types.name: Allocation
types.description: Abstract allocation object maintained by the verifier.

fields.name: start
fields.description: The allocation start address.

fields.name: size
fields.description: The allocation size in bytes.

fields.name: written
fields.description: Whether every byte in the allocation has been written according to KLEE's source-level initialization mask.

fields.name: end
fields.description: The first address after the allocation.

fields.name: layout
fields.description: The original layout associated with this allocation.

fields.name: allocator
fields.description: The allocator identity that created this allocation.

types.name: MemoryRange
types.description: A half-open byte range [start, end) derived from a pointer and a size.

fields.name: start
fields.description: The first address in the range.

fields.name: size
fields.description: The range size in bytes.

fields.name: end
fields.description: The first address after the range.

fields.name: allocation
fields.description: The allocation containing the range start.

types.name: RustRange
types.description: A half-open Rust slice index range [start, end) in element units.

fields.name: start
fields.description: The first element index in the range.

fields.name: end
fields.description: The first element index after the range.

fields.name: size
fields.description: The number of elements in the range.

fields.name: size
fields.description: The layout size.

fields.name: align
fields.description: The layout alignment.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable verifier-local allocator id.

types.name: TypeInfo
types.description: Verifier view of a type argument at the target callsite.

fields.name: size
fields.description: size_of::<T>() when known, otherwise a symbolic value.

fields.name: align
fields.description: align_of::<T>() when known, otherwise a symbolic value.

fields.name: is_zst
fields.description: Whether the pointee type is zero-sized.

operators.name: get_arg
operators.description: Returns the target call argument by index, using the verifier's __klee_argN binding convention.

operators.name: get_result
operators.description: Returns the target call's result. KLEE evaluates this after the callsite's target callee returns.

operators.name: get_field
operators.description: Returns a typed field from an object. Valid fields and return types are defined in types.

operators.name: memory_range
operators.description: Constructs a half-open byte range [ptr.address, ptr.address + size).

operators.name: within
operators.description: Tests membership in the half-open interval [start, end). For a MemoryRange subject, tests full range containment and permits an empty range at end.

operators.name: memory_between
operators.description: Constructs the half-open byte range between two addresses, independent of their order.

operators.name: offset_does_not_wrap
operators.description: Uses mathematical 128-bit arithmetic to check that ptr plus a signed offset, an unsigned add offset, or an unsigned sub offset does not cross the address-space boundary. direction is signed, add, or sub.

operators.name: mul_fits
operators.description: Uses 128-bit mathematical multiplication and checks that the result fits the target integer type. target is one of isize, usize, i32, u32, i64, or u64; pointer-sized targets use KLEE's current pointer width. Plain operands are non-negative mathematical integers; wrap a signed operand with as_signed.

operators.name: as_signed
operators.description: Interprets a bit-vector value as isize, i32, or i64 and sign-extends it for mathematical arithmetic.

operators.name: rustrange
operators.description: Constructs a half-open Rust slice index range [start, end) in element units.

operators.name: get_type_at_func
operators.description: Returns metadata for the indexed type parameter of the target callee.

operators.name: is_power_of_two
operators.description: Returns whether x is a non-zero power of two.

operators.name: is_aligned
operators.description: Returns whether ptr.address is aligned to align.

operators.name: is_valid_for
operators.description: Returns whether the range is valid for the requested access. read requires allocation containment/readability, write additionally requires a writable allocation, and read_write is their conjunction. Initialization is a separate is_initialized_for_type rule.

operators.name: is_initialized
operators.description: Legacy byte-only initialization check. Prefer is_initialized_for_type when validating a Rust value.

operators.name: is_initialized_for_type
operators.description: Requires every byte in range to be written and applies supported Rust type-validity constraints from TypeInfo (currently exact for bool; other types retain byte-initialization semantics).

operators.name: allows_uninitialized_value
operators.description: Returns whether a value of this Rust type may legally be wholly uninitialized.

operators.name: is_valid_c_str
operators.description: Returns whether ptr is non-null and reaches an initialized NUL byte within one allocation.

operators.name: c_str_in_allocation
operators.description: Returns whether the complete CStr byte range through its terminator is contained in one allocation.

operators.name: has_nul_terminator
operators.description: Returns whether ptr has a reachable initialized nul terminator.

operators.name: is_valid_for_c_str
operators.description: Applies an access/lifetime condition to the complete CStr range rather than a fixed byte prefix.

operators.name: is_convertible_to_ref
operators.description: Atomic predicate for Rust raw-pointer-to-reference convertibility.

operators.name: is_allocated_via
operators.description: Returns whether ptr denotes a currently live block allocated by the specified allocator identity; the string global denotes Rust's global allocator.

operators.name: not_overlapping
operators.description: Returns whether two half-open byte ranges do not overlap.

constants.name: USIZE_BITS
constants.description: Number of bits in Rust usize.
